title: Variance-ratio regime gate: 15m 24-hour-high breakout only when short-horizon returns trend
ex_ante_rule: Chart 15m, closed candles only; a signal at the close of bar t is executed at the open of bar t+1. Long only, one position at a time, whole balance, same rule and parameters on every pair. DEFINITIONS: r(i) = ln(close(i)/close(i-1)). VARIANCE RATIO VR(t) over the 384-bar window of returns r(t-383..t): q(i) = r(i-3)+r(i-2)+r(i-1)+r(i) (overlapping 4-bar sums), taken for i = t-380..t so all its returns lie inside the window (381 values); VR(t) = sample variance (ddof=1) of those q(i) / (4 * sample variance (ddof=1) of r(t-383..t)). In pandas: q = r.rolling(4).sum(); VR = q.rolling(381).var() / (4 * r.rolling(384).var()). HTF FILTER: build 4h candles from the 15m data in UTC blocks starting 00,04,08,12,16,20 (informative 4h via merge_informative_pair, ffill, so only COMPLETED 4h candles are visible); the filter is true when the last completed 4h close > simple mean of the last 50 completed 4h closes (that close included). ENTRY at the close of bar t when ALL hold: (1) close(t) > highest high of bars t-96..t-1 (prior 24 hours, current bar excluded); (2) VR(t) >= 1.10; (3) HTF filter true; (4) no open position. No cooldown. EXIT, the first of: (a) at the close of any bar after the entry bar, close < lowest low of the prior 16 bars (current bar excluded) -> sell at the next open; (b) TIME EXIT: at the close of the 96th 15m bar counted from the entry bar (the bar whose open was the fill), sell at the next open, so no position lasts more than 24 hours; (c) STOP-LOSS: fixed 5% below the entry price, native intrabar stop (protective only; exits (a) and (b) are the intended exits). No take-profit, no trailing stop, no pyramiding, no other filters. Warm-up: 900 bars (4h SMA50 = 800 bars of 15m plus up to 15 bars of 4h-block alignment, rounded up; the VR window needs 385). startup_candle_count = 900.
rationale: Zargar and Kumar (2019) apply variance-ratio tests to Bitcoin at 15, 30, 60 and 120 minute and daily sampling: daily returns look like a martingale, but higher-frequency returns reject it, and the inefficiency varies through time (moving-window tests). Wen, Bouri, Xu and Zhao (NAJEF 2022) study intraday crypto return predictability and frame it as switching between momentum (late-informed traders) and reversal (overreaction). A variance ratio above 1 at a 4-bar (1h) horizon means 15m returns have recently been positively autocorrelated: herding, stop/liquidation chains and slow diffusion of information. In such a regime the counterparties are late buyers and forced short-covering that keep paying up after a 24-hour-high breakout; when VR is below 1 breakouts tend to fade and are skipped, which targets the failed-breakout losses of plain Donchian rules (H-002). The 4h trend filter keeps entries in the direction of the larger move. Expected frequency: a fresh 24h high on 15m in a 4h uptrend occurs a few times a week per pair, and the VR gate removes perhaps half, so roughly 150-300 trades per year per pair. Per-trade move: a breakout of the 24h range held up to 24 hours with an exit only below the 4h low lets typical winners run 1-3% (15m crypto daily ranges are about 3-5%), aiming at gross moves above about 0.8%, well over the 0.30% base and 0.45% conservative round trip. The Wen et al. abstract was not read; only its bibliographic record was found.
novelty_vs_tried: No family in the lab conditions entries on a measured return-autocorrelation statistic. H-002 (DonchianBreakoutBaseline) traded every 20-bar breakout with no regime gate and a 10-bar-low exit and lost to costs; here the breakout is taken only when the variance ratio says short-horizon returns are currently trending, and every trade is time-bounded to 24h. VolatilitySqueezeBreakout gates on range compression (volatility level), not on serial dependence; WeeklyBreakoutRegime/RisingTrendBreakoutGate gate on slow moving averages and hold for days or weeks. IntradayJumpContinuation and HourlyRangeExpansionDrift react to single-bar size, not to the autocorrelation structure of 384 bars.
